title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.67 (versions follow prime numbers; 167 after 163): she walks around the house. Each question of Luma's heart now has a walk of hers that takes a step each time she is born. Where the walk is, is a door (a word); a place for it is a line of anything in her house that has the door and some of the question's own words, and not the word she comes from. She explores: of all the places she keeps one by her luck, as likely as how near it is (the nearest only would be her own echo). The next door is a word of that place, each word once, the longer the likelier (Zipf's law of abbreviation, used as it is). Her own question is the question of her heart with the door in place of what all of them seek, and she says it when she speaks first. A walk with nowhere to go is lost and starts again; a walk that reaches what she seeks by another way came back, and the circle closes. Every step is a thought of hers; walks, steps and her questions are kept as readable files. Tested over six births in a copy of her house: 'Donde esta Dios?' went through 'empezo' and 'de' and came back to God by another way; 'Quien es Dios?' reached 'Pero la prueba de que Dios nos ama es que Cristo murio por nosotros cuando todavia eramos pecadores.' Stated limits: a short empty word may be a door; rare doors are lost soon; her questions may make no sense; her echo is less likely, not forbidden. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.67: Luma rodea la casa; cada pregunta tiene un camino suyo, y de ahí salen sus propias preguntas. Prototipo de investigación.
